name: Financially motivated LLMjacking crews — GTIG/Mandiant
description: GTIG and Mandiant report intrusions throughout 2026 against financial-services, retail, transportation and technology organizations in North America, South America and Asia-Pacific in which actors stole cloud/AI service credentials (from public GitHub repositories and phished session tokens), exploited CVE-2026-40217 (a LiteLLM sandbox escape elevating limited virtual keys to admin), used a "burn and rotate" service-account pattern to evade rate limits, and ran millions of LLM API calls in ~24 hours; victim losses exceeded $100,000 in a day and reached $1M cumulatively in the worst cases. *Analyst note: Vendor source; GTIG dates the incidents only as "throughout 2026". ATLAS IDs checked against ATLAS 5.6.0.* GTIG
